description: This file defines data structures, functions, and logic for processing user usage events into training data for machine learning models. It includes data classes, utility functions for slot alignment, cyclical feature encoding, and a main function to build training examples from usage event streams.

classes.name: SlotKey
classes.description: An immutable data class representing a unique key for a usage slot, identified by user ID, instance ID, and slot starting datetime.

methods.name: datetime _align_to_slot_start(dt: datetime, slot_minutes: int)
methods.description: Aligns a given datetime to the start of its slot boundary based on slot length in minutes.

methods.name: Iterable[datetime] _iter_slots(start: datetime, end: datetime, slot_minutes: int)
methods.description: Generates an iterable of slot start datetimes within a specified interval, aligned to slot boundaries.

methods.name: Dict[str,float] _cyclical_features(hour: int, day_of_week: int)
methods.description: Creates cyclical features (sine and cosine transforms) for hour of day and day of week to encode cyclic temporal patterns.

methods.name: List[TrainingExample] build_training_data( events: Iterable[UsageEvent], slot_minutes: int = DEFAULT_SLOT_MINUTES, min_history_days: int = 7, )
methods.description: Main function converting usage events into a list of labeled training examples with engineered features suitable for machine learning consumption.

ctags.name: _iter_slots
ctags.pattern: /^def _iter_slots(start: datetime, end: datetime, slot_minutes: int) -> Iterable[datetime]:$/

ctags.name: build_training_data
ctags.signature: ( events: Iterable[UsageEvent], slot_minutes: int = DEFAULT_SLOT_MINUTES, min_history_days: int = 7, )
